video_title: Nuggets In Danger Of LOSING Jokic? - Debating If Denver Will Accidentally Push A Star Away

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Denver's contract offer to Kentavious Caldwell-Pope before the sign-and-trade
quotes.excerpt: The Nuggets offered Watson around four years and 70 million.
quotes.quote: The Nuggets, from what I understand, offered Watson around four years and 70 million. I checked on it. I am not sure it was at 70 million, it might have been a hair under. And they offered him that deal before the Thunder put them to the test with Spencer Dinwiddie on that six million dollar a year deal.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Denver had options to trade Cam Johnson to avoid luxury tax penalties
quotes.excerpt: The Nuggets had options to trade Cam Johnson and get him off their books.
quotes.quote: From what I am told, the Nuggets had options to trade Cam Johnson and get him off their books. There were teams that were willing to do that where it wouldn't have been penal to them. They could have moved Cam Johnson. I am not sure that they could have moved Christian Brown for value. They probably could have traded him but not for actual value. But they could have traded Cam Johnson and they could have not matched on Spencer Dinwiddie. They made the decision to keep those two guys.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Denver's failure to extend Christian Brown and sign Kentavious Caldwell-Pope last fall
quotes.excerpt: That's when Christian Brown got a five-year 125 million dollar extension and they couldn't come to an agreement.
quotes.quote: If you want to talk about what's happened to the Nuggets roster, you have to go back to really last fall. And that's when Christian Brown got a five-year 125 million dollar extension and they couldn't come to an agreement with Kentavious Caldwell-Pope who at the time wanted mid-level money, wanted like 14 million a year and the Nuggets wouldn't go a dollar over 10 million was my understanding. Look, hindsight's 20/20. If they had to do all over again, they had to give Kentavious Caldwell-Pope his 14 million and waited on Christian Brown and been in discussions with him and they probably would have been able to keep them both.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Denver's current 75 million dollar tax bill after losing key rotation players
quotes.excerpt: They have a 75 million dollar tax bill that's staring them in the face.
quotes.quote: Even after losing Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, who was one of their five best players, Tim Hardaway, who was the six-man-of-the-year candidate, even after losing those two guys from last year's roster, they have a 75 million dollar tax bill that's staring them in the face and they're over the second apron to get bounced in the first round and get worse.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The risk of wasting Nikola Jokic's prime years in Denver
quotes.excerpt: You have one of the greatest players of all time who took you to the top.
quotes.quote: You have one of the greatest players of all time who took you to the top of the mountain and you are in serious danger of essentially wasting the rest of his career.

quotes.speaker: Tim McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Denver's current situation to the Dirk Nowitzki era in Dallas
quotes.excerpt: Even if Joker stays, he's staying and it's awesome, it's a one-franchise legend.
quotes.quote: Or I'll give you another example, it'll become the Dirk Nowitzki situation where even if Joker stays, he's staying and it's awesome, it's a one-franchise legend, he's loyal, but he doesn't have a chance to compete for a championship for the rest of his prime into his twilight.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of Michael Porter Jr.'s contract on Denver's trade flexibility
quotes.excerpt: Michael Porter Jr. who they traded for Cam Johnson, he makes 40 million this year.
quotes.quote: Michael Porter Jr. who they traded for Cam Johnson, he makes 40 million this year. And the differential in those two salaries was one of the reasons, one of the primary reasons that Denver included a first-round pick to Brooklyn as part of that deal. So, you know, that was a factor.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic's current participation with the Serbian national team
quotes.excerpt: Jokic is playing a friendly with the Serbian national team in Belgrade against Team France.
quotes.quote: As we speak, Jokic is playing a friendly with the Serbian national team in Belgrade against Team France, Victor Wembanyama is playing.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert's physical condition and role with the French national team
quotes.excerpt: Rudy Gobert is playing alongside Victor. Victor was by the way named French national team captain.
quotes.quote: Rudy Gobert is playing alongside Victor. Victor was by the way named French national team captain, which isn't a surprise, but there's some older guys on that, like Evan Fournier is on the team and there's some guys who have won real medals and real stuff for the French. But I was talking to a scout and he told me, not that this should be a surprise, but he told me that Rudy Gobert looks in spectacular condition.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Marvin Bagley III's role as a bench scorer for the Wizards
quotes.excerpt: The one rotation player they brought in this year is Marvin Bagley III.
quotes.quote: The one rotation player they brought in this year is Marvin Bagley III who, you know, he can score off the bench, but he's a journeyman who should be at the spot.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cleveland's need for a backup big man and interest in Kevin Love
quotes.excerpt: The Cavs need another big man and Kevin Love is out there.
quotes.quote: The Cavs need another big man and Kevin Love is out there and that's a guy to keep an eye on for Cleveland. They, I think the Cavs would love to have Marvin Bagley III on the, so they should have tried to get, tried to try to try to try to get him in that deal.
